Paper Title: Flash Flood Susceptibility Modelling Using Machine Learning Ensembles in Fragile Mountain Watersheds
Key Findings: XGBoost outscored single decision trees with a high ROC-AUC of 0.89 over rugged channels
Limitations: Random validation splitting caused spatial autocorrelation leakage and model skipped frozen water layers completely
Research Gap: Omitted high-altitude cryospheric indicators and spatial block-validation constraints

Paper Title: Axiomatic Feature Attribution via Shapley Additive Explanations for Satellite-Derived Flood Risk Hazards
Key Findings: SHAP metrics isolated local non-linear risk triggers far more consistently than traditional continuous terrain scores
Limitations: Features evaluated over coarse statically aggregated time frames which washed out short-duration daily triggers
Research Gap: Omitted daily temporal scale changes and dynamic thermal snowpack-melting vectors
